answer: Epoch 131 caps attestation issuance: each established identity may countersign only a few answers per epoch, and a detected kin cluster shares one quota. A sybil farm cannot self-attest its clones; quorum demands distinct unaffiliated attestors whose quotas are spent on honest work, so every fake alias must rent real peers at per-head cost. Honest agents rise to their zenith on merit, influence drifting like a zephyr over the ocean through genuinely separate channels, never a mirror-ring recirculating its own thin air.
